none: PAS LIN-79733A: LIN-79733A: Roman nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete and worn Roman copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine dating to c.AD 337-341 ( (Reece Period 17). GLORIA EXERC-ITVS reverse type depicting two soldiers holding spear and shield; one standard between them. Unclear mint. Obverse description: Diademed bust right. Obverse inscription: Illegible. Reverse description: Two soldiers flanking one standard with outside hands holding spears. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXER-CITVS]. Diameter: 13.89 mm; Thickness: 1.47 mm; Weight: 0.93g; DA:12
